leg_command: bash C:/t/corr-assess/g3/leg.sh <base|after> <PMC> <strict|research>  ==  gate(holder absent, free RAM>=4GB) then: bounded_run.py --heavy-lock corr-g3 --timeout 6000 -- python -u -X utf8 C:/t/corr-assess/scripts/live_launch.py --script <tree>/scripts/batch_run.py --topics C:/t/corr-assess/g3/topics/<PMC>.txt --modes <mode> --out C:/t/bt-corr/g3/legs/<arm>-<PMC>-<mode> --fresh --timeout 5400 --deadline 1.7  (cwd=<tree>, env T2PW_EXTRACTION_DRAWS=3 PYTHONPATH=<tree>/src)

PHASE B research, same order (6 legs) if time
PHASE C extra: L8 7b papers, strict only, both arms, if A and B finish within budget

estimate.total_AB_h: ~8-8.5, at the ~8 h limit: strict first, research after
estimate.llm_cost_usd: unmeasured here; prior 3-draw legs not recorded in cost; estimate ~1-4 USD per leg (3 extraction draws at up to 64k tokens + curator loop); after-arm usually costs the same tokens (draws concurrent), measured from run artifacts

scoring: C:/t/corr-assess/g3/score_g3.py (acceptance.score_run on pinned_v1 + eval_v2 reactions.score_leg on gold_v2 cases + PWML tag counts + model_attempt counts from LEG_TRACE)
